scenes.line1: How does Django keep code and data in sync?
scenes.line2: What makes it so fast to build apps?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how Django keeps your code and database working together, and why building apps feels so fast?

scenes.label: MVT
scenes.sub: Model-View-Template splits data, logic, and UI.
scenes.say: Django uses the Model-View-Template pattern. That means your data, logic, and user interface are separate and easy to manage.
You define your data as Python classes. Django's ORM turns these into database tables, so you never write raw SQL.

scenes.title: Migrations in Action
scenes.say: When your models change, just run the migration commands. Django updates your database schema to match your code.

scenes.label: Admin
scenes.sub: Instant CRUD UI for your models.
scenes.say: The admin interface gives you a ready-made dashboard to create, read, update, and delete data. No extra code needed.

scenes.question: What does the T in MVT stand for?
scenes.right: Template handles the user interface, not the data.
scenes.say: Here's a common mistake: thinking Template means database model. Actually, Template is all about the user interface.
